data.name: Battle for Mountain Throne
data.detailed_description:
Battle for the Mountain Throne is immersive VR game about Bloody Wars between inhabitants of Mountain Kingdom: Dwarves, Goblins and other deadly cave dwellers.

You will take the role of mighty Hero from Dwarven people, who is ready to crush thousands of enemies both on top of the snowy peak and much deeper in the shade of dungeons to confirm your rights on the Mountain Throne!

There are plenty of battles with enemy hordes and powerful monsters, deadly traps and large, hard to conquer levels in the game.

The Game consists of several battles at different locations with numerous opponents.
Player gets various combinations of weapons, optimal for passing each level, selected from these types:
- handgun,
- battle axe,
- war hammer,
- shield,
- bombs.

Main objective on the level usually is one of these tasks:
- simple victory over all waves of opponents,
- survival for a certain time,
- passing through the level.

Important game's feature - complete physical interactions with opponents:
- strong hammer blows allow to throw enemy into the abyss,
- accurate shots lead them to turning over,
- targeted attacks are blocked by the shield.

It is worth to note that opponents are not easy prey - if player looks aside and miss several attacks, enemies can get him shortly.
Game is really challenging and even most experienced players can enjoy.

>>>>>>>game developed for HTC Vive and Oculus Touch

reviews.review:
[h1] Experienced on the Oculus Rift with Touch Controllers [/h1]

[i]Full disclosure: I got this game free from the Steam Curator program. I did not play it for 1.8 hours. I think I idled for about 1 hour of that play period. So I didn't finish the game, which is something I would normally do when I get a game on the Steam Curator program as I feel it is my obligation to fully experience the game before I can review it. Which is weird, because I don't feel the same way when I purchase a game. I feel when I buy a game I can review it on my first impression of the game, before getting past the 2 hour mark of no return.[/i]

In any event, there's a reason why I am reviewing the game after playing it for only about 45-50 minutes. That's because I couldn't get past a level/wave because of a game breaking-bug which prevented me from progressing. I tried several attempts to get past the bridge crossing level, to no avail as each time I would eventually lose my axe weapon. Without a weapon, you can't attack and kill the mobs necessary to get past the bridge. This happened repeatedly.

I have no idea why you can lose your weapon. Once you grab a weapon or shield, they should stick to your hands. But instead, touching grip loses grip of your weapon. Now, I am certain I did not touch grip and still the axe would go flying out of my hand eventually after a number of swings. I tried different ways to swing my weapon to prevent it, but it would eventually happen each time.

Even before that game-breaking bug, however, I wasn't really having fun. The graphics are mediocre at best. But the core gameplay is clunky. Combat just never felt fluid or satisfying, despite the different weapons used. The variety of goblins was nice (and later the fire golems), but taking them down never felt fun. The animations were off too. I would see goblins float in the air after climbing up to where you were standing. The death animations looked funny. When you would shoot your gun, it just never looked right. You could only tell you hit your target because the goblin would fall flat on the ground.

This game feels like it's in alpha stage. I know it's Early Access, but it's too buggy at this point for anyone to enjoy. It's like we're beta (really alpha) testers and paying for the privilege. No thanks! I know $7.99 USD is not a lot, but if you're buying this game you're banking on the dev really improving this game a lot between now and it's final release. We all know what usually happens to most EA games so I woudln't count on that improvement with a game released on EA with this many issues.

Rate 4/10. Only buy if you really believe this game will be much better in the future. And dev please comment on my post if you've updated the game to a level where you think I would change my mind about your game. I would love to change my review to positive, but please don't comment unless you've made a serious update to this game. I have more games (that I paid for) than time at this point.
